content: We need to indicate number of CH3 groups in the molecule. But we have no description of molecule. Possibly need to retrieve NMR spectra to infer? But we don't know the molecule. Maybe the sample is "the sample at hand" meaning there is a hidden molecule. We can get 1H NMR to count methyl signals. Use proton_nmr_spectra tool (no input needed). It will return spectra string. Then we can count number of methyl peaks (triplet around 0.9 ppm etc). Could also use carbon NMR to count methyl carbons (~10-30 ppm). Simpler: get carbon NMR and count signals in methyl region. Use carbon_nmr_spectra tool. Let's call carbon_nmr_spectra.
